text:
mike.sales: Hey team — Prospect (HelixCare) needs a concise IAM package for their security review tomorrow: SSO metadata, example SAML assertion (with groups), RBAC mapping CSV, and confirmation that MFA is enforced for all console and admin logins. Can we assemble by EOD?

sara.security: Yep. Minimum artifacts: IdP metadata.xml, redacted saml-response example, short MFA policy blurb, RBAC/role mapping CSV, and a statement on API/service-account scoping and key rotation. Keep the pack tight (1 page summary + attachments).

josh.eng: I'll grab the current metadata.xml and produce a redacted saml-response.txt. Will include sample attribute names (email, groups, user_id).

anya.devx: Note: HelixCare asked for examples showing group->role mapping and default least-privilege. Suggest we show the default org role = viewer and a sample mapping table.

paul.solutions: I'll format the CSV with columns: customer_group, redwood_role, allowed_scopes. Example row: "engineering,admin,models:read,models:write,deployments:*". Also will call out the default viewer role for new orgs.

mike.sales: Great. Sara — can you draft the MFA blurb and audit retention line? They might push on evidence for enforcement.

sara.security: MFA blurb (short): "Redwood enforces MFA for all human users. For SSO logins we rely on the customer's IdP (we recommend Okta/AzureAD) and require at least two factors (password + TOTP or WebAuthn). For direct console accounts MFA is enforced via Redwood's provider. Adaptive policies are enabled for high-risk sign-ons. Authentication and MFA challenge events are logged and retained for 365 days; exports available in CSV/JSON on request."

josh.eng: Example SAML Attribute snippet (redacted) to include in bundle:
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">
    <saml:AttributeValue>alice@helix.org</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups">
    <saml:AttributeValue>helix-admins</saml:AttributeValue>
    <saml:AttributeValue>helix-readonly</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

anya.devx: For the CSV use this sample snippet so they can import: 
```csv
customer_group,redwood_role,allowed_scopes
helix-admins,admin,models:read;models:write;routes:manage
helix-readonly,viewer,models:read;metrics:read
```

paul.solutions: Service account guidance to include: scoped API keys tied to roles, policy names like `infer:invoke` or `routes:read`. Keys are rotatable via API; recommend < 30 day lifetime for POC keys and use least privilege. We'll include an example curl to create a scoped key.

mike.sales: They also asked about SAML assertion validity and replay protections.

sara.security: Add this: "We accept SAML assertions with NotOnOrAfter <= 5 minutes from issuance, enforce Recipient and Audience checks against our ACS/entityID, and validate InResponseTo when present. We reject unsigned assertions and require IdP signing; we also check assertion timestamps to mitigate replay."

josh.eng: I'll attach metadata.xml and redacted saml-response.txt into the POC folder. I'll also include sample ACS and entityID values and the minimal SP config keys.

paul.solutions: Plan for bundle: 1-page summary (MFA + retention + assertion lifetime + API keys) + metadata.xml + redacted saml-response + role-mapping CSV + service-account snippet. I'll keep it to 2 pages of reading.

upload-bot: Note: shared-drive upload limit at 91% usage. If any file > 10MB, please attach to the ticket instead.

anya.devx: Quick review after upload; will sanity-check attributes and CSV headings. If Helix needs a signed attestation escalate to GRC and Sara will sign off.

mike.sales: Thanks all — HelixCare is on a security call at 4pm, aiming to deliver bundle before 3pm. I'll follow up once files are uploaded.
